title: 恐龙的爪子
subtitle: 抓、挖、还是钩
character: wearing a brick red t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible pencil strokes and layered hatching, brick red, warm grey and pale olive

pages.zh:
柜子里放着一只爪子。
又长又尖，
比我的手还大。
爸爸说，
这只恐龙还不吃肉。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy in a museum leaning close to a glass case, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth open in surprise; inside the case stands one very long pale claw as big as his hand.

pages.zh:
我们看见的爪子，
其实只是骨头。
真的爪子
外面还套着一层壳，
比骨头还长一截。

这只恐龙叫镰刀龙。
它的爪子
有我的胳膊那么长，
是所有恐龙里
最长的一双手。

这么长的爪子
不是用来打架的。
它把高处的树枝
一根根钩下来，
慢慢吃上面的叶子。
pages.scene: One large long-armed dinosaur standing on two legs on a cream background, hooking a high branch down towards its mouth with the long claws of one hand. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
还有一种爪子
长在脚上。
第二个脚趾上
挂着一只大钩子，
走路的时候翘着。

翘着是为了不磨坏。
要用的时候
才放下来。
一下子扣进去，
再也挣不开。
pages.scene: One small feathered two-legged dinosaur standing on a cream background with one foot lifted, the big hooked claw on its second toe pointing down. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
前面那三根手指
也带着爪。
三根能合到一起，
像三把钩子
一起抓住东西。

另有一种恐龙，
爪子又短又粗，
像三把小铲子。
它不抓东西，
它专门挖。
pages.scene: One small two-legged dinosaur on a cream background digging into a tall termite mound with its short thick front claws. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
挖土的爪子
又宽又钝，
像一把铲。
抓肉的爪子
又细又尖，像一把钩。

最大的那些恐龙
反而没什么爪。
前脚粗得像柱子，
只在里面那根趾头上
留了一个。
pages.scene: A close view of the thick round front foot of one huge long-necked dinosaur standing on a cream background, one single claw on its inner toe. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
钩的、抓的、挖的，
还有干脆不用的。
爪子长成什么形状，
就等于告诉你
它是干什么用的。

我把手举到玻璃上，
跟它比了一下。
我的指甲
也是那层壳做的，
只是短得多。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy holding his open hand up against the glass of a museum case, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, comparing his short fingernails with one huge pale claw behind the glass.
